title: Midweek 26, 2026
preheader: Friday, June 26: Office Hours, project-share slots, Dubai Future Horizons, Futuring 2.0, and the four Design Fiction books.

hero.headline: Weekly Office Hours.
hero.body:
Weekly Office Hours is open for this Friday. Come by for the usual generous, curious, smart group conversation around Design Fiction, speculative practice, creative work, side projects, tools, systems, and whatever else is moving through the Lab orbit this week.

There are project-share slots open. If you have something you want help with, bring it. The format is tight: 10 minutes to introduce the project, share slides, show what you are making, or frame the question, followed by 20 minutes of polite, useful group feedback and help.
hero.imageAlt: Office Hours N°314 event image from Luma

sections.label: Featured from the Lab

items.title: The Four Design Fiction Books
items.subtitle: Four printed references for Design Fiction, imagination, artifacts from possible futures, and speculative scenarios.
items.body:
The Manual of Design Fiction, It's Time to Imagine Harder, TBD Catalog, and Androids Dream of Electric Sheep are bundled together as a compact shelf of Near Future Laboratory practice.

If Office Hours gives you the conversation, these books give you the longer-form references: methods, examples, prompts, artifacts, and ways to keep your own work moving.
items.imageAlt: Four Design Fiction books from Near Future Laboratory

sections.label: Also from the Lab

items.title: Dubai Future Horizons
items.subtitle: Human by Design: Who Will We Become?
items.body:
On June 30, I’ll join Professor John E. Katsos and host Felix Zeltzer for a Dubai Future Horizons conversation on identity, ethics, resilience, and the human capabilities we will need to navigate the futures we are creating.

The session is live on Zoom at 10:00 AM Eastern, 7:00 AM Pacific, and 6:00 PM Dubai time.
items.imageAlt: Dubai Future Horizons Human by Design event graphic, orange version

items.title: Futuring 2.0
items.subtitle: Futuring in Print at The Shop at MATTER
items.body:
In collaboration with The Shop at MATTER, I’ll be running a workshop and seminar on futuring on June 27 in Denver with Becky Vartabedian, PhD.

The seminar covers the history of futuring, methods and tools, and how the practice is evolving in the context of AI and other emerging technologies. The workshop is a hands-on session where participants can apply futuring techniques to their own projects and challenges.

offer.headline: Want to share a side project?
offer.body:
Sign up to do a project share at Office Hours. You get 10 minutes for the presentation, slide share, demo, or introduction, then 20 minutes of generous, polite group feedback and help.

Bring a rough question, an unfinished prototype, an idea that needs witnesses, or a project that would benefit from other people's attention.
